sanctuary.label: The Sanctuary Era
sanctuary.heading: 1983–1985: The Sanctuary Era
sanctuary.description: Following the 1981 Shap Fell disaster, Rhys and Claire retreated to a soundproofed ranch house in Williamsport, Maryland. Refusing to hire session musicians in the studio, the siblings physically played every instrument themselves before staging their legendary 1985 stadium manifestation.

albums.title: Carnaby Street
albums.description: Written in the safety of a transatlantic sanctuary following a devastating loss. A sweeping progressive pop record where profound grief meets an eventual emotional breakthrough, physically played entirely by the surviving siblings.

Set entirely within the gaslamp-lit halls of the Victorian-era Hollow Square in 1883 London, this concept rock opera brings the four deceased siblings back to life through intricate analog synthesizer clockwork and Gwen's wooden flute.

albums.title: Live at Independence Stadium
albums.description: Recorded live in August 1985 before 90,000 fans in Philadelphia, featuring the extended stadium rendition of 'The Hollow Square'.
